# Octogram

> Octogram is a fast-paced mobile word game. Swipe through a grid of letters, chain words, and race the clock across five unique modes. Available on iOS and Android.

## Pages

- [Home](https://octogram.app/): Overview of Octogram, its game modes, and features.
- [Download](https://octogram.app/download): Get Octogram on the App Store and Google Play.
- [Support](https://octogram.app/support): Help, FAQs, and how to contact the Octogram team.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://octogram.app/privacy): How Octogram collects, uses, and protects your data.
- [Terms of Service](https://octogram.app/terms): The terms governing use of Octogram.
- [Delete Account](https://octogram.app/delete-account): How to delete your Octogram account and associated data.
